personal.subject: Supper tonight
personal.body: I have kept some soup warm for you. The rain has started again, so the streets will be unpleasant after work. Take your time coming home.

personal.subject: You left your scarf
personal.body: Your scarf is still on the chair by the window. I'll put it by the door for tomorrow. Take your umbrella too; the sky already looks grey.

personal.subject: A little news
personal.body: The upstairs neighbour sang off-key all afternoon again. It made me laugh. I think he chose that song you dislike just to annoy us.

personal.subject: At the market
personal.body: I found lovely pears at the market and saved two for you. If you get home early, we can have them with coffee.

personal.subject: Just a note
personal.body: The house is very quiet without you. Don't rush on my account; write when you know what time you'll be home.

personal.subject: Sunday together
personal.body: I asked your sister if she's coming on Sunday. She'll bring her apple cake. Tell me if you'd rather keep the day to ourselves.

personal.subject: The hall lamp
personal.body: The hall lamp is flickering again. I've asked the caretaker to come by tomorrow. I hope your day went better than mine.

personal.subject: I miss you
personal.body: I was thinking about our walk along the river. We should do it again when the weather clears. All my love.
